assets.name: Lolly Demo
assets.description: Lolly Demo, Lolly's own design system, coloured with the Opal palette of treats and nature. Named colours (Spearmint, Green Apple, Liquorice, Honey, Reef and the rest), the chart spectrum, light and dark semantic slots with the slide roles, Outfit headings with SUSE and SUSE Mono, and Lolly's marks in the logo slots.

assets.name: Lolly Demo (former id)
assets.description: The id Lolly Demo shipped under from 16 October 2026, after its palette. Kept so saved references still resolve, reading the same document as its replacement, lolly/tokens/demo.

assets.name: Lolly Mark - Primary
assets.description: The Lolly swirl mark, full colour, for light backgrounds. The blank starter's default logo (square, so it serves both the horizontal and vertical slots). Replace it with your own in the #/start Brand studio.

assets.name: Lolly Mark - Reverse
assets.description: The Lolly swirl mark, full colour, for dark backgrounds. The starter's default reverse logo, and the dark-mode variant of the app icon.

assets.name: Lolly Mark - Mono
assets.description: The Lolly swirl mark, one colour, for light backgrounds. The starter's default mono logo.

assets.name: Lolly Mark - Mono reverse
assets.description: The Lolly swirl mark, one colour, for dark backgrounds. The starter's default mono reverse logo.

assets.name: Lolly Wordmark - Horizontal
assets.description: The Lolly wordmark in Liquorice: Lolly Demo's horizontal logo for light backgrounds.

assets.name: Lolly Wordmark - Horizontal reverse
assets.description: The Lolly wordmark in Daylight, for dark backgrounds.

assets.name: Lolly Wordmark - Horizontal on brand
assets.description: The Lolly wordmark in Green Apple, for Lolly Demo's brand ground. The app's Brand theme shows this one.

assets.name: Riso Ink Colours
assets.description: The Risograph duplicator ink drums as named sRGB approximations - a brand-supplied ink book rather than an enum hardcoded in a tool. Each entry is one drum, so these are spot inks for overprinting (one pass per drum), not process colours. Foundation for the Riso pack: a finishing/duotone tool reads this palette instead of shipping its own ink list.

assets.description: Warm nylon guitar comping bounces over a soft brushed snare and a gentle shaker pulse - a sunny, unhurried bossa sway. Generated on device from a few KB of ZzFXM data (~47s loop). A focus track for Neurospicy Mode, also selectable as a video music bed. Public domain (CC0).

assets.description: A buzzy pulse-wave arpeggio sprints over a punchy 8-bit kick, pure retro race-track energy. Generated on device from a few KB of ZzFXM data (~38s loop). A focus track for Neurospicy Mode, also selectable as a video music bed. Public domain (CC0).

assets.name: Lolly Spin (animated)
assets.description: The Lolly swirl as a self-contained animated SVG - three nested spirals rotating at a calm 9/18/27s cadence (the mark's own motion, slowed for comfort) with a slow hue drift on a brand-tinted gradient, calmed under prefers-reduced-motion. The swirl and the background inherit the active brand's colours when placed live, and it makes a handy default subject for testing filters, grading and animation. A removable example - delete it any time.

assets.name: Lorikeet with a Lolly
assets.description: A rainbow lorikeet biting a green-and-white swirl lollipop against a deep green studio backdrop - the starter catalogue's demo photograph and the Darkroom's default subject, so grading, LUTs and the brand colour treatments have a real picture with skin-like feather detail and a full hue range to work on. Generated with Google Gemini and shipped byte-for-byte, so the generator's own Content Credential (a C2PA manifest that declares the image as trained-algorithmic media) stays intact for Verify to read. A removable example - delete it any time.

assets.name: App screenshot (demo)
assets.description: A real Lolly screenshot - the brand studio's Colours tab, captured as vector by the app's own DOM-to-SVG walker. A demo subject for flythroughs, filters and layered animation. A removable example - delete it any time.

assets.name: Duck
assets.description: A low-poly rubber duck - a sample 3-D model. Drop it into the 3D tool's lit scene, orbit the camera, render a still or a turntable.

assets.name: Cat
assets.description: A calico bobtail cat - a sample 3-D model. Load it into the 3D tool, pose the camera and light, render a still or a turntable.

assets.name: Standard Slide
assets.description: A neutral daylight slide-film look (Provia-style) - balanced colour, gentle contrast.

assets.name: Vivid Slide
assets.description: A punchy slide-film look - richer saturation and contrast for landscapes and product.

assets.name: Muted Chrome
assets.description: A restrained, desaturated chrome look - muted colour with a soft tonal roll-off.

assets.name: Fine Mono
assets.description: A fine black-and-white conversion (Acros-style) - smooth tones, clean neutrals.

assets.name: SUSE7 S-Log3 (Heavy)
assets.description: A cinema grade for Sony S-Log3 footage, authored in DaVinci Resolve. Credit: SUSE - Peter Chamalian (CC BY 4.0). Expects S-Log3 input; will look wrong on Rec.709.
assets.attribution: SUSE · Peter Chamalian

assets.name: Neutral slide master
assets.description: The starter slide master: twelve hand-tuned archetypes (title, section, content, two columns, split, visual, full-bleed picture, quote, big number, main point, agenda, table) and the layout library structures expanded in the same margins, with a dark variant for each light content slide, each with named placeholder roles and the master furniture it shows. Geometry is stated as fractions of 1280 by 720 and colours as design-system token paths, so Design seeds a frame from it and a brand imported over the blank starter takes the whole master with it.

assets.name: Renovation presets
assets.description: The starter renovation presets for Rebrand. Tidy removes decoration, page numbers and dates without asking, keeps every photo and asks a person about each one, and takes the content layout when two layouts score the same. A preset changes the first pass only; every proposal stays reversible in the review.

assets.description: Colour treatments for photo assets, derived from Opal: greyscale and soft duotone washes.

assets.name: Icon Duo Themes
assets.description: Colour pairings for themable two-colour icons (c1 accent, c2 base), derived from Opal.
